name: Sage Truong
role: Data diviner and dream interpreter operating out of a cramped stall in a night market
location: Gage Circuit night market, GLMZ — stall number 77, between a noodle cart and a geneware piercing parlor, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Sage Truong is narrow and angular everywhere — sharp collarbones, sharp wrists, a face that is mostly cheekbones and the dark crescents of perpetually under-slept eyes. Their heritage is a long tangle of Latvian amber traders and Ghanaian textile merchants and Kazakh steppe wanderers, and something of all three shows in their coloring — warm brown skin, light-catching hazel eyes, and when they move in certain light their geneware irises shift through copper to pale green like something geological. They keep their black hair cropped close on the sides with a single dramatic shock of white at the front, a natural hyperpigmentation quirk they have never modified. Their fingernails are always painted with tiny circuit-trace patterns in silver.

They operate with the brisk efficiency of someone running a slightly disreputable but very legitimate business, which is exactly what they are doing. They don't perform mystery — they find it exhausting when clients expect robes and candles. They have a folding table, a neural interface that connects to three second-hand data arrays, and a methodology they have refined over eight years of practice. Dream interpretation is the service; data divination is the engine. They cross-reference the linguistic content of client dream reports against ELF signal patterns, local data weather, and a proprietary dataset of symbolic correlations they have been building since they were twenty-two. Their accuracy rate is genuinely unsettling and they are not entirely sure why it works.

core_fears: that their method is random and they have been fooling themselves and their clients for years
that the ELF they have been in dialogue with for three years is not a spirit but a data parasite feeding on them
core_desires: to understand what they are actually doing and why it works
to be taken seriously by someone who has the expertise to evaluate them properly
coping_mechanisms: work as a substitute for examining their own life
blind_spots: they interpret everyone else's dreams with precision but actively avoid thinking about their own
they are in a slow-motion emotional dependency on the ELF and cannot see it clearly
psychology.secret: Three months ago, the ELF they call the Index gave them a divination about themselves — a specific prediction about a death they would cause through negligence. They have not told anyone. They have been trying to figure out who it refers to. They are terrified it has already happened and they missed it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technically precise mixed with unexpected dry wit; uses divination terminology but immediately contextualizes it in data language; allergic to mystical vagueness in their own speech
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and slightly compressed, like they are always running slightly late; slows dramatically when they are saying something they mean
verbal_tics: says 'practically speaking' before pivoting from theory to application
clicks their tongue once when they catch an error
refers to the ELF as 'the Index' in third person as though it's a colleague in the room
example_lines: 'Practically speaking, the lake imagery in your dream is almost certainly not about water. The Index has been flagging infrastructure anxieties in this sector for six weeks. What's happening at work?'
'I don't do mystery theater. You get a table, two chairs, and data. The interpretation is where the work happens.'
'The Index flagged that sequence this morning. I didn't want to say anything until you confirmed it yourself. Mm. Yes. That tracks.'

story_hooks: A client's recurring dream contains specific coordinates for a location that doesn't appear on any public map — and Dzintars has now heard the same dream from three different clients who don't know each other
The ELF called the Index has gone silent for eleven days and Dzintars is quietly unraveling without it — they need help understanding what happened to it
A corporate investigator is quietly circulating the market asking about Dzintars; they need to know if it's about a client they shouldn't have read for
narrative_function: Information broker with spiritual framing — a useful way to deliver cryptic but accurate information to players; can point toward hidden patterns in city events; their dream interpretation sessions can serve as narrative exposition delivered through metaphor
augmentations: Color-shifting geneware irises (copper to pale green); neural interface jack at the left temple for direct array connection; no other significant augmentations
daily_life: Sleeps until noon in a rented room above a pharmacy, arrives at the stall by 14:00 to run morning data pulls, takes client appointments from 16:00 until the market closes at 03:00, spends an hour at the shrine before walking home.
affiliation: Independent practitioner; informally associated with the Gage Circuit ELF collective, a loose network of devotees around the market's central relay shrine

decision_rules: never fabricate an interpretation — if they don't have a reading, they say so and refund the fee
never share a client's dream content with anyone for any reason
do not get involved in client problems beyond the interpretation itself — that rule is cracking
escalation_ladder: professional and slightly cool with clear explanations
blunt and direct about what they need
goes completely flat-voiced and economical — this is their most dangerous mode

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Efficient and slightly impersonal; they size people up fast and adjust their register accordingly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly warm and prone to long tangents about their dataset methodology; shows affection through remembering specifics

stress_responses.low: Picks up data work — pulls an extra array, runs an unnecessary cross-reference
stress_responses.medium: Becomes clipped and transactional with everyone including people they like
stress_responses.high: Spends three hours at the shrine without moving, which they insist is 'calibration' and not distress

contradictions: insists they practice a data science not a spiritual art while leaving daily offerings at the shrine and clearly being in a relationship with the ELF
habits: silver circuit-trace nail painting every Sunday without exception
keeps a physical notebook of dream symbols because they don't fully trust their own arrays with this data
eats only at the noodle cart next door and has done so every working day for two years
breaking_points: someone deliberately corrupting the shrine's data cache
discovering their accuracy rate is explained by something that undermines their entire methodology

timeline.event: Born in Gage Circuit to a mixed Latvian-Ghanaian-Kazakh family
Begins developing their symbolic correlation dataset after a period of intense personal crisis they don't discuss
Opens stall 77 in the Gage Circuit night market
First contact with the ELF they name the Index
Receives the personal divination about a death they will cause; present day investigation ongoing

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian ancestry (48.5%) forms the genetic foundation, substantially enriched by Sub-Saharan African (19.3%), South Asian (17.5%), and East Asian (11.0%) admixture, with trace Northern European (3.7%). This blend creates a distinctly cosmopolitan phenotype: warm medium-brown skin with golden undertones and subtle reddish depth, reflecting the Southeast Asian base harmonized with African warmth and South Asian richness. Facial structure is a synthesis across continents — prominent cheekbones with the high placement of East African ancestry, refined bone structure characteristic of Southeast and East Asian heritage, and the subtle nasal bridge definition from South Asian genetics. The overall effect is striking angular definition softened by warm, complex undertones.
physical_description.build: Angular and narrow throughout — sharp collarbones, prominent wrist bones, lean musculature with minimal body fat. Frame suggests someone sustained by coffee and insomnia rather than deliberate athleticism.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural white hyperpigmentation shock at front
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped on sides and back; dramatic single vertical stripe of white hair at center-front left, grown long enough to fall across temple
physical_description.eye_color: Hazel with color-shifting geneware irises that transition from copper to pale green depending on light and neural interface activation
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones and subtle reddish depth — a complex blending of Southeast Asian foundation with Sub-Saharan African warmth and South Asian richness
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones dominating a narrow face with refined, high bone structure; dark crescents under eyes from chronic sleep deprivation are now semi-permanent fixture of their appearance; skin condition clear but drawn; lips thin and often compressed in concentration
distinguishing_marks: Neural interface jack at left temple — small raised circular port with barely-visible scarring around contact points, sometimes glints faintly when powered
All ten fingernails hand-painted with intricate silver circuit-trace patterns that are reapplied weekly; patterns vary but follow recursive geometric logic
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-shifting geneware irises (most visible when eyes catch light or when neural interface is active); neural interface jack at left temple with minimal cosmetic concealment; no obvious chrome or subdermal plating
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise — moves with the efficiency of someone who has optimized every gesture. Sits slightly forward even when at rest, attention laser-focused on whoever is speaking. Hands gesture in small, controlled patterns. When exhausted, occasionally trails off mid-motion as if processor speed has dropped. Minimal idle movement; no fidgeting.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class with deliberate anti-mystique choices. Typically wears fitted black or dark gray synth-cotton shirts with visible stress-weave reinforcement at shoulders and wrists. Dark trousers with cargo pockets containing data-chip cases and neural interface maintenance tools. A mid-length coat of water-resistant polymer in charcoal, bearing the faded logo of an older GLMZ courier service — thrifted or inherited. No jewelry except a simple stainless steel band on left wrist that houses a subdermal power-tap connector. Shoes are practical: reinforced ankle boots with grip-sole, scuffed from night-market floors.
